jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
As a People Business Partner at Sage, you work alongside the leaders who move the business forward, helping them build stronger teams, steer through change, and turn ambitious plans into results that hold up. You bring a clear point of view, a steady presence, and the kind of judgment leaders come to rely on. You tend to see what is coming before it arrives, and you are usually already thinking about what to do about it.

What You Will Own

Leading change that sticks. Guiding transformation, workforce planning, restructuring, and cross-functional projects with clear goals, visible sponsorship, disciplined communication, collaborator alignment, and enough structure to keep the right people moving together without slowing the work down.
Being the voice leaders rely on. Partnering with senior leaders as they set direction, offering clear guidance, candid input, and the kind of decision-focused meeting leadership that helps teams align quickly and leave with shared ownership of next steps.
Building teams that perform. Shaping talent, performance, engagement, and organizational design so people do their best work, teams pull in the same direction, and the business can grow without losing its footing.
Letting the evidence lead. Turning people metrics, patterns, and trends into choices you can defend, outcomes you can measure, and practical answers leaders can act on.
Solving the problems that do not come with a playbook. Spotting risk, gaps, and openings early, asking better questions, testing practical options, and bringing creative, sound answers before small issues grow into large ones.
Connecting the wider system. Working hand in hand with global P&C teams and Centers of Excellence while navigating complex employee relations, performance, and compliance matters toward outcomes that are fair, sound, scalable, and right for the business.

You will thrive here if

You meet leaders where they are. No two leaders are alike, and you adjust your approach to their style, context, pressure points, and readiness without losing your authenticity or lowering the bar.
You can translate without diluting. You know how to turn people strategy, policy, data, and change into language that makes sense to the leader in front of you, whether they need the headline, the risk, the options, or the next practical step.
You say what needs saying in a way it can be heard. You give leaders the straight version, even when an easier answer is sitting right there, and you know when to challenge, when to coach, and when to create space for them to get there.
You trust your own read. You are comfortable taking a position and standing behind it, and you bring original thinking instead of reaching for the default playbook.
You know the edge of what you know. When you are not certain, you say so and go find the answer, because getting it right matters more to you than appearing to have it all figured out.
You move with the business. Fast pace, shifting ground, more questions than answers? That tends to be where you do some of your best work, because you can bring enough structure, judgment, and calm to help leaders keep moving.

What You Bring

Strategic Influence and Change Leadership

A track record of becoming the trusted voice behind business leaders in complex or global organizations.
Real experience guiding transformation and change, not just watching it happen around you.
A practical change-management toolkit: clear case for change, stakeholder mapping, sponsor alignment, communication cadence, manager enablement, adoption tracking, and reinforcement after launch.
The ability to shape thinking and direction at senior levels through influence rather than authority.

Business and People Expertise

Deep command of modern people practices, including organizational design, talent strategy, and workforce planning.
A history of translating business strategy into results-driven people plans.
Sound judgment in employee relations and the complex, human realities of organizational life.

Data and Insight

Genuine comfort with data, and the skill to turn it into recommendations people can act on.
Experience using metrics to prove what is working and improve what is not.

Project Management and Meeting Leadership

The ability to organize complex work into clear plans, owners, achievements, and follow-through that keep projects moving.
Confidence leading meetings that have purpose, pace, and outcomes, especially when the room includes senior leaders or competing points of view.
Strong facilitation skills that help groups focus, make decisions, resolve ambiguity, and leave knowing what happens next.

Agility and Execution

A calm, solution-first approach when priorities shift and the ground keeps moving.
The ability to hold competing demands and still deliver with both quality and pace.
Creative problem solving that combines curiosity, data, business context, and good judgment to move from ambiguity to a workable path forward.
A naturally collaborative style that connects easily across teams and geographies.

Leadership and Trust

Communication that engages, earns trust, and works at every level of the organization.
Emotional intelligence and balanced judgment, especially when the pressure is on.
A real commitment to inclusive practice and to building a culture of accountability, performance, and belonging.

We are hiring a Senior HR Operations Specialist to strengthen employee-lifecycle delivery, global leave and benefits operations, HRIS data quality, controls, reporting, and continuous improvement. This role combines hands-on operational ownership with the ability to redesign workflows, remove duplicate work, and implement practical automation across HR and partner systems.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable resolving a complex employee transaction, diagnosing a data issue, coordinating a cross-functional process, and converting recurring manual work into a controlled, measurable workflow.

Responsibilities:

Manage complex onboarding, job changes, transfers, exits, and related employee-lifecycle processes across jurisdictions.
Maintain accurate HRIS records and lead data-quality audits, reconciliations, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Design and improve request, approval, notification, document-generation, and system-integration workflows.
Manage global leave and benefits operations.
Build operational dashboards and exception reporting.
Own compliance reporting and tracking activities.
Partner with IT, Legal, Finance, Payroll, Total Rewards, PBPs, managers, and vendors.
Own the HR operations optimization pipeline.

Requirements:

Significant HR operations experience.
Strong HRIS expertise; ADP preferred.
Demonstrated success simplifying or automating processes.
Working knowledge of global leave administration and benefits operations.
Advanced Excel and reporting skills; Power BI valued.
Experience with Workato, Power Automate, ServiceNow, APIs, or similar.
Strong project management and communication skills.
Service mindset and employee support focus

Assets
:

Experience managing compliance calendars, audits, filings, and remediation tracking.
Experience creating knowledge bases, playbooks, training materials, and self-service resources.
While being based in the Denver area is preferred, we welcome candidates from other locations.

Benefits:

Competitive salary commensurate with experience & qualifications.
A comprehensive extended benefits package.
A great team environment and resources, supporting you to do the best work of your life and providing unlimited career growth potential.
Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial environment.
On going support for learning development so you can continue to master your craft.
Work with the hardware you're most comfortable with (Windows or Mac)
Diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn from each other.
Excellent work-life balance with a flexible remote work environment.

jobs.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About The Role

As Hims & Hers continues to scale, the complexity of our business, leaders, and organization continues to grow. We're looking for a Principal HR Business Partner to help shape what's next.

This is a highly strategic role that requires exceptional business acumen as much as HR expertise. The right person will develop a deep understanding of our business, operating model, and leadership priorities, then translate that understanding into building organizations, leadership teams, and talent strategies that enable the business to move faster and scale effectively.

You'll serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping shape not only organizational decisions, but how leaders think about organization, leadership, and talent. You'll bring an independent point of view, challenge assumptions, connect patterns others don't see, and help leaders navigate the moments that matter most.

This role is equally about solving today's challenges and building the organizational capability needed for tomorrow. Success isn't defined by the number of decisions you support. It's defined by the quality of the organizations, leaders, and operating models you help build.

You Will

Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping shape business strategy through organization design, leadership, and talent.
Lead organization design, workforce planning, and succession efforts that position the business for its next stage of growth.
Partner with leaders to design organizations that create clear ownership, accelerate decision making, and enable teams to scale.
Coach senior leaders through organizational change, leadership transitions, performance challenges, and other high-impact business moments.
Bring a clear, well-reasoned point of view to complex organizational decisions, helping leaders evaluate tradeoffs and move forward with confidence.
Identify emerging organizational risks and opportunities by connecting themes across leaders, teams, and the broader business before they become barriers to execution.
Build practical, scalable approaches that improve how leaders lead, how teams operate, and how the organization grows over time.
Partner closely with Recruiting, Compensation, Employment Legal, HR Operations, and other People leaders to ensure business decisions are supported with thoughtful, integrated People strategies.
Raise the standard for HR partnership by modeling exceptional business thinking, organizational insight, and leadership influence while helping develop other HRBPs across the team.
Master, own, and interpret People programs (e.g., Compensation, Legal, Performance) to provide authoritative guidance to the business, knowing that strategic partnership at this level is built on a foundation of operational excellence.

You Have

12+ years of progressive HR experience, including senior HRBP partnership in operational or complex environments
Significant experience partnering with senior business leaders in complex, high-growth organizations.
Demonstrated success leading organization design, workforce planning, leadership development, and talent strategy.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex business challenges into practical organizational solutions.
Proven ability to influence executive leaders through credibility, thoughtful challenge, and a clear point of view.
Experience helping organizations navigate growth, transformation, and organizational change.
Demonstrated ability to anticipate organizational issues, connect patterns across the business, and proactively solve problems before they slow the organization down.
Strong executive presence with the confidence to coach leaders, challenge assumptions, and influence important business decisions.
A builder's mindset with a track record of creating scalable approaches that improve how organizations operate over time.
Ability to move seamlessly between long-term strategy and hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We're committed to building a team that reflects diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe different ways of thinking make us stronger, and we're dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, supported, and empowered to do their best work.

If you're excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply—even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification. We know that great candidates often bring transferable skills and unique perspectives that don't fit neatly into a checklist.

Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Human Resources Business Partner to provide strategic HR partnership to senior Commercial leaders, with a focus on supporting Sales and field-based commercial teams across the US and Canada. This senior individual contributor role will partner closely with the VP, HR for Sales and senior business leaders, including executive-level stakeholders, to shape talent strategy, strengthen organizational effectiveness, and support business performance. The role requires strong corporate HR experience, commercial acumen, and the ability to operate with influence in a complex, matrixed environment.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with the VP, HR for Sales and senior Commercial leaders to align people strategies with business priorities, growth objectives, and workforce needs.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive and senior leadership teams, providing strategic guidance on talent, organization design, leadership effectiveness, workforce planning, and change leadership.
Support HR strategy and execution for Sales and field-based commercial teams, ensuring people plans reflect the needs of distributed, customer-facing organizations.
Lead and support talent review, succession planning, leadership development, and high-potential identification processes, using data and insights to strengthen organizational capability.
Advise leaders on organizational change initiatives, including restructuring, operating model changes, productivity reviews, team effectiveness interventions, and change adoption planning.
Provide guidance on performance management, policy interpretation, employee relations, investigations, and workplace concerns, supporting consistent and compliant application of company policies and employment practices.
Use workforce analytics, talent metrics, and business data to identify trends, evaluate organizational health, and recommend practical actions that improve leader and employee experience.
Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence, People Operations, Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders to deliver integrated HR solutions that support business outcomes.
Coach leaders on effective communication, inclusive leadership, employee engagement, accountability, and team performance.
Contribute to continuous improvement of HR processes, tools, and practices to enhance efficiency, consistency, and impact across the Commercial organization.

Essential Requirements

Significant progressive Human Resources experience, including substantial experience in a senior HR Business Partner role within a corporate environment.
Demonstrated experience supporting Sales, Commercial, field-based, customer-facing, or revenue-generating teams.
Experience providing HR partnership to executive-level and senior leadership stakeholders, including the ability to influence, advise, and challenge leaders constructively.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to understand business drivers, translate priorities into people strategies, and connect HR initiatives to measurable business outcomes.
Proven experience operating in complex, matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and cross-functional decision-making.
Strong capability in organizational design, workforce planning, talent reviews, succession planning, leadership effectiveness, employee relations, and performance management.
Experience supporting organizational change, including restructuring, change communication, stakeholder alignment, and adoption planning.
Strong employee relations judgment, including experience advising on workplace issues, policy application, investigations, and risk-aware decision-making.
Excellent consulting, coaching, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility and trust at all levels.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret workforce data, identify trends, and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
Ability to balance strategic influence with hands-on execution in a senior individual contributor capacity.
Clear, effective communication skills, including the ability to present complex information to senior leaders in a concise and practical way.
Demonstrated commitment to inclusive leadership practices and fair, consistent employment processes.

Desirable Requirements

Experience supporting Commercial or Sales teams in food safety, life sciences, diagnostics, manufacturing, industrial, technology, healthcare, or other regulated or technical industries.
Experience partnering with global or multinational teams, including exposure to cross-border HR practices and geographically dispersed workforces.
Experience supporting large-scale sales transformations, go-to-market changes, territory redesign, or commercial effectiveness initiatives.
Experience working with HR Centers of Excellence to deploy enterprise talent, rewards, learning, engagement, or workforce planning programs.
Familiarity with HR systems, workforce dashboards, engagement platforms, or people analytics tools.
Advanced degree or professional HR certification, such as SHRM-SCP, SHRM-CP, SPHR, PHR, or equivalent.

What We Offer

A senior, high-impact HR business partnering role with direct exposure to Commercial and HR leadership.
The opportunity to shape talent strategy, leadership effectiveness, and organizational capability across a key business area.
A collaborative, matrixed environment where strategic thinking, operational excellence, and continuous improvement are valued.
The opportunity to partner with experienced HR and business leaders on meaningful workforce and organizational initiatives.
A standard benefits package.
An inclusive recruitment process that welcomes candidates with a range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

The Role

The HR Generalist & Talent Acquisition Specialist will serve as Spotlight Media's primary recruiter and HR point person.

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and interviewing, knows how to identify strong candidates, and can quickly understand what makes someone a good fit for a particular role.

You will be responsible for managing the recruiting process from sourcing through initial interviews while also overseeing the company's day-to-day HR administration, including onboarding, offboarding, payroll coordination, time-off tracking, employee documentation, and employee relations.

Key Responsibilities

Own Spotlight Media's recruiting process from job opening through candidate handoff/hire.
Develop and execute proactive recruiting strategies to identify qualified candidates.

Manage employee offboarding and ensure a smooth transition when employees leave the company.

Track vacation, sick time, and other employee time-off.
Maintain company HR policies and documentation.

Coordinate with payroll providers and/or internal leadership regarding payroll issues.
Maintain accurate employee information and compensation records.
Help ensure HR processes are consistently followed across the organization.

Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees regarding HR-related questions and concerns.
Partner with managers and leadership on employee performance and workplace issues.
Help managers navigate employee performance concerns and disciplinary situations.
Participate in employee termination processes when warranted.
Conduct termination/offboarding meetings when appropriate and ensure the process is handled professionally and respectfully.
Maintain appropriate confidentiality when dealing with sensitive employee information.
Help leadership identify and address employee-related issues before they become larger problems.

What We're Looking For

3+ years of professional HR and/or recruiting experience.
Significant hands-on recruiting experience, particularly with outbound candidate sourcing.

Experience recruiting for multiple types of roles, rather than specializing in only one position or industry.

You should also be comfortable switching gears. One day you may be sourcing candidates for an Account Manager; the next you may be onboarding a new employee, helping a manager address a performance issue, processing payroll information, or conducting an employee offboarding.

For over four decades, PAR Technology Corporation (NYSE: PAR) has been a leader in restaurant technology, empowering brands worldwide to create lasting connections with their guests. Position Description

We are seeking a Senior Manager, NA Talent Acquisition, to lead our North America recruiting team and serve as a trusted talent advisor to business leaders and hiring managers across the organization. This role is responsible for translating workforce needs into thoughtful staffing strategies, aligning recruiting resources to business priorities, and driving hiring outcomes across technical, go-to-market, and corporate functions. The successful candidate will bring strong people leadership, recruiting expertise, and operational discipline, with the ability to coach hiring managers through complex hiring decisions, leverage data and insights to improve outcomes, and balance speed, quality, and candidate experience while leading a high-performing recruiting team.

Position Location:
US – Remote (Eastern or Central time zone)

Reports To:
Head of Global Talent Strategy

What We’re Looking For

8+ years of progressive talent acquisition experience, including leadership of recruiting teams in fast-paced, growing organizations
Proven track record hiring across technical, GTM, and corporate/business functions simultaneously
Experience managing a distributed/remote recruiting team
Strong command of TA metrics (time-to-fill, offer acceptance, quality of hire) and how to use them to drive decisions
Hands-on experience with modern ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, or similar) and a track record of driving adoption of new tools or systems
Experience partnering with senior leaders and hiring managers on workforce planning, staffing strategy, and hiring prioritization
Strong ability to influence and hold hiring managers accountable throughout the hiring process
Comfort operating in ambiguity

Additional Skills

Experience using AI, automation, and recruiting technology to improve efficiency and hiring outcomes
Strong ability to influence hiring leaders and drive accountability throughout the hiring process
Experience using recruiting metrics and market insights to inform workforce planning and talent decisions
Demonstrated success leading, coaching, and developing recruiting teams
Strong commitment to candidate experience, structured hiring, and continuous improvement

Unleash your potential: What you will be doing and owning:

Lead and develop a high-performing remote recruiting team by setting priorities, coaching team members, removing obstacles, and ensuring consistent delivery against hiring goals
Own hiring outcomes end-to-end: deliver hundreds of hires per year across diverse functions and levels while improving time-to-fill and pipeline quality in parallel
Drive candidate experience and conversion: maintain a best-in-class offer acceptance rate through strong candidate experience and close partnership with hiring teams
Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to develop thoughtful staffing plans, prioritize hiring needs, assess talent market realities, and align recruiting efforts to business objectives.
Build strong partnerships with hiring managers by setting clear expectations, driving hiring discipline, and ensuring effective decision-making throughout the recruiting process.
Implement structured hiring practices: roll out and continuously improve intake processes, calibrated interview loops, and scorecards that raise hiring manager satisfaction and hiring quality
Optimize recruiting technology, processes, and reporting to improve team productivity, hiring manager experience, and decision-making
Elevate employer brand: own the careers site and job description strategy to improve applicant quality and grow employee referrals
Leverage recruiting metrics and market insights to identify opportunities, improve hiring outcomes, and provide data-driven recommendations to business leaders
Manage vendor, agency strategy and RPO: optimize agency partnerships and vendor spend to stay below market cost benchmarks without sacrificing quality
Evaluate and implement technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools that improve recruiter efficiency, hiring manager experience, and candidate engagement

Company Description
Hospitality Services Group (HSG) is a premier hospitality company that provides professional staffing solutions to organizations across the hospitality industry. • Previous recruiting leadership or supervisory experience preferred
• Staffing agency experience strongly preferred
• High-volume recruiting experience preferred
• Hospitality or service-industry recruiting experience is a plus
• Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Experience with ATS platforms, Indeed, job boards, and candidate sourcing tools
